channels_physical_wire.name: LIN bus line
channels_physical_wire.purpose: Shared single-wire data bus between master and slaves. Idle = recessive (pulled toward VBAT via 1 kΩ master / 30 kΩ slave termination). Active dominant pulls toward GND via the transmitting transceiver.

channels_physical_wire.name: VBAT
channels_physical_wire.purpose: Battery rail providing pull-up for bus termination (12 V typical).

channels_node_uart_side.name: TXD
channels_node_uart_side.purpose: Logic-level UART transmit. Driven by the node's UART/SCI peripheral; transceiver translates to dominant on the bus when TXD low.

channels_node_uart_side.name: RXD
channels_node_uart_side.purpose: Logic-level UART receive. Transceiver reports bus state to the node's UART/SCI peripheral; node samples for byte fields.

channels_transceiver_control.name: EN / SLP / WAKE
channels_transceiver_control.purpose: Transceiver mode control (normal / low-power / wake) — implementation defined; the LIN protocol does not standardise these pins.

frame_field_signal_catalog.name: Break field
frame_field_signal_catalog.purpose: Frame-start delimiter; ≥13 dominant nominal bit times + ≥1 recessive Break Delimiter.

frame_field_signal_catalog.name: Sync byte field
frame_field_signal_catalog.purpose: 0x55 UART byte field; provides alternating edges for slave bit-time measurement.

frame_field_signal_catalog.name: Protected Identifier (PID)
frame_field_signal_catalog.purpose: 8-bit field: ID0..ID5 + P0 + P1; identifies the frame and triggers publish / subscribe roles.

frame_field_signal_catalog.name: Data 1 .. Data N
frame_field_signal_catalog.purpose: 1..8 payload bytes; transmitted LSB-first (little-endian for multi-byte entities).

frame_field_signal_catalog.name: Checksum
frame_field_signal_catalog.purpose: Inverted 8-bit sum-with-carry; classic over data bytes, enhanced over PID + data.

signal_types_supported_by_protocol.notes: Packed within frame data bytes; can cross byte boundaries.
Byte-aligned within the frame data field; LSB byte first.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All bus activity is initiated by the master task. Each frame slot is a header + at most one response. Slaves never initiate; they may only respond to a header whose PID they publish (or send a wake signal from Bus sleep mode).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Slave response data is bound to the PID transmitted in the slot's header. response_error in a status-carrying unconditional frame depends on the success/failure of all prior non-event-triggered frames since the last response_error transmission.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering: LSB-first on the wire (each UART byte field) and LSB-byte-first within the frame data field (little-endian).
ordering_rules.field_ordering: Break → Sync → PID → Data 1 .. Data N → Checksum, with optional inter-byte spaces.

global_signals.name: response_error
global_signals.purpose: 1-bit scalar published by every slave in one of its transmitted unconditional frames. Cluster-wide health indicator.

global_signals.name: NAD
global_signals.purpose: 8-bit Node Address for Diagnostics, used in master-request / slave-response frames to address a specific slave.

global_signals.name: Supplier ID + Function ID + Variant
global_signals.purpose: 16-bit + 16-bit + 8-bit slave identification, returned by Read by Identifier.
